# Androperator Documentation

Load the page matching the current task. These references describe the source build; verify installed CLI/Operator compatibility. The full corpus is optional, not a mandatory reading sequence.

## Start or repair

- Docs home: choose a route: https://docs.androperator.com/
- Host orientation: select interface, target and readiness: https://docs.androperator.com/host-agents/
- Quickstart: ready-host observe/action/result loop: https://docs.androperator.com/quickstart/
- Setup: install or repair prerequisites: https://docs.androperator.com/setup/

## Choose inputs and interpret results

- CLI reference: command syntax and owners: https://docs.androperator.com/api/cli/
- Execution payloads, envelopes and output parsing: https://docs.androperator.com/api/overview/
- Action inputs and output examples: https://docs.androperator.com/api/actions/
- Selectors: exact matching, strictness and containers: https://docs.androperator.com/api/selectors/
- Scoped selection: repeated rows and ambiguity: https://docs.androperator.com/api/scoped-selection/
- Devices, package discovery and emulator CLI routing: https://docs.androperator.com/api/devices/
- Budgets and distinct timeout outcomes: https://docs.androperator.com/api/timeouts/

## Observe and retain evidence

- Raw/compact hierarchy, source completeness and artifacts: https://docs.androperator.com/api/snapshot/
- Still/video bundles, partial outcomes and artifact retention: https://docs.androperator.com/api/evidence/
- Notification reads and authorized mutations: https://docs.androperator.com/api/notifications/
- Media state and controls, including background readiness: https://docs.androperator.com/api/media/
- Navigation recipes and transition-wait semantics: https://docs.androperator.com/api/navigation/
- Human demonstration capture and NDJSON export: https://docs.androperator.com/api/recording/
- On-screen logs and visibility receipts: https://docs.androperator.com/api/on-screen-logs/

## Connect a transport or configure a host

- HTTP: remote device host, endpoints and errors: https://docs.androperator.com/api/serve/
- MCP: stdio tools and transport-specific results: https://docs.androperator.com/api/mcp/
- Daemon: lifecycle and uncertain proxy responses: https://docs.androperator.com/api/daemon/
- Configuration: supported settings and precedence: https://docs.androperator.com/api/environment/

## Diagnose an observed failure

- Errors: typed codes, dispatch evidence and recovery: https://docs.androperator.com/api/errors/
- Doctor: interactive/background gates and check results: https://docs.androperator.com/api/doctor/
- Logging: NDJSON and correlation: https://docs.androperator.com/api/logging/
- Operator: installation, permissions and service failures: https://docs.androperator.com/troubleshooting/operator/
- Compatibility: exact CLI/APK version checks: https://docs.androperator.com/troubleshooting/compatibility/
- Known limitations and bug reporting: https://docs.androperator.com/troubleshooting/known-issues/
- Performance: investigate latency with evidence: https://docs.androperator.com/troubleshooting/performance/
